title: Creative Advisor - Human Frontier Collective (US)
description:
About the Collective
 The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI. As a Creative Advisor , you’ll bring your creative practice into direct collaboration with Scale’s research and ML teams. You’ll help them understand how work gets made in your field, develop new work together, and provide feedback on how AI models support—or fall short of—real creative processes.
 What You’ll Do
 Connect with other creators: Meet and learn from creatives and researchers across HFC and your industry.
 Shape work in your domain: Share the taste, judgment, methods, and creative decisions behind your practice to help inform model development.
 Create alongside the team: Collaborate on briefs and develop new work that helps explore what models can and cannot do in your field.
 Partner with ML and research teams: Define what “good” looks like in your field, review model outputs, flag where AI falls short, and give feedback that shapes how models learn your craft.
 Help peers understand the opportunity: Introduce other creators in your field to the program and share your experience contributing work.
 Who Should Apply
 We’re looking for leading creators in their field who are interested in shaping AI and how it’s changing creative work. No AI experience needed. Your expertise in your craft matters most, and being connected to others in your field is a plus. This is a paid, part-time role with a flexible schedule.
 Why Join
 Have a voice: Contribute your subject-matter expertise and perspective in your domain. Build the future by shaping frontier models.
 Collaborate across disciplines: Work with ML and research teams and connect with other leading creatives.
 Explore new creative possibilities: Make new work through paid, commissioned briefs that challenge what models are capable of doing.
 Get paid for your expertise: Paid $300 hourly, with compensation, time commitment, and project scope shared during your interview.

title: Accounting Partner Growth Manager
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Why join us
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Partnerships at Brex
 Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.
 What you’ll do
 Brex’s Accounting Channel is undergoing exponential growth, and we are looking for a partner manager to accelerate the team. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of shaping and expanding our market presence, driving a critical engine of our company's success. We're on the hunt for a dynamic professional who excels at forging powerful alliances in the accounting and OCFO ecosystems. You’ll be responsible for building strong relationships, cultivating partnerships from the ground up, seamlessly integrating new partners into our ecosyst…
